description: This file contains utility functions related to DNS operations, including handling DoH provider entries, generating URLs from templates, mapping connection types to time deltas, creating DNS name pointers, converting DNS query types, and translating secure DNS modes to strings. It also includes functions for obtaining DoH servers based on hostname or nameservers, and for retrieving provider IDs for histograms.

methods.name: GetDohProviderEntriesFromNameservers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of DoH provider entries matching the given DNS server endpoints, considering feature flags and avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: GetURLFromTemplateWithoutParameters
methods.description: Expands a URI template string into a URL, with no parameters substituted.

methods.name: GetTimeDeltaForConnectionTypeFromFieldTrial
methods.description: Reads a time delta value from a field trial configuration based on connection type.

methods.name: GetTimeDeltaForConnectionTypeFromFieldTrialOrDefault
methods.description: Returns a time delta from field trial or a default if not available.

methods.name: CreateNamePointer
methods.description: Creates a DNS name pointer (compressed label) with the given offset.

methods.name: DnsQueryTypeToQtype
methods.description: Converts a DnsQueryType enum to its corresponding wire protocol type code.

methods.name: AddressFamilyToDnsQueryType
methods.description: Maps an address family to its corresponding DNS query type.

methods.name: GetDohUpgradeServersFromDotHostname
methods.description: Returns a list of DoH server configurations for a given hostname if matching provider entries are enabled.

methods.name: GetDohUpgradeServersFromNameservers
methods.description: Returns DoH server configurations based on a list of DNS server endpoints.

methods.name: GetDohProviderIdForHistogramFromServerConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the provider ID string for histogram purposes based on a DoH server configuration.

methods.name: GetDohProviderIdForHistogramFromNameserver
methods.description: Retrieves the provider ID string for histogram purposes based on a nameserver endpoint.

methods.name: SecureDnsModeToString
methods.description: Converts a SecureDnsMode enum value to its string representation.
